prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 产品对比 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 79px
  col 2: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 50px
  col 3: header "屏幕" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 100px
  col 4: header "续航" · longest unbreakable word 20px · one-line width 59px
  col 5: header "重量" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 39px
  col 6: header "评价" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 445px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者比较四款手机的价格、规格与评价，找到适合自己的型号。","reading":"读者先按型号定位，再横向比较同一行的价格、屏幕、续航、重量和评价；也会纵向扫描同一指标。行高应由较长的评价自然决定，其他单元格可利用同一行的高度换行。","groups":["型号是每行的识别入口；价格是独立的购买指标。","屏幕、续航和重量都是可纵向比较的规格，宽度应支持数字与单位的辨认。","评价是描述性文字，与前面的短规格不同，需要更多换行空间。"],"keep_intact":["价格及其货币符号和数字","型号中的 X1、Pro、Air、Max 等标识","屏幕尺寸、分辨类型以及重量数值和单位应尽量保持易读"],"may_wrap":["型号名称可在系列名与后缀之间换行","屏幕尺寸与面板类型可分行","续航的约数和天数可在自然位置换行","评价可按中文语义自然换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [56, 71, 55, 46, 47, 84] · table 360×694px · row heights [60, 199, 176, 106, 153] · column headers wrapped 2/6 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 3
Design r2B: widths [56, 71, 60, 51, 51, 70] · table 360×857px · row heights [60, 246, 246, 106, 199] · column headers wrapped 2/6 · tallest cell 10 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [59, 71, 55, 46, 51, 77] · table 360×857px · row heights [60, 246, 246, 106, 199] · column headers wrapped 2/6 · tallest cell 10 lines · mid-word splits 3

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"价格完整，评价栏相对宽，四款产品之间的行界限清楚，评价也比另外两个方案更容易连续阅读。","problems":"屏幕面板类型被拆成 OLE/D 和 LTP/O；续航、重量表头竖排，重量数字与 g 分行。型号中的 Pro 另占一行。","cause":"屏幕列 55px 只提供 34px 内容宽度，容不下 39px 的最长词；续航列 46px 和重量列 47px 都不足以横排两个汉字的表头或让重量数值与单位保持在一起。型号列 56px 使系列名和后缀需要分行。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"屏幕列能完整保留 OLED、LTPO 和 LCD，价格完整，规格中的词没有被拆开；型号也仍可辨认。","problems":"评价栏过窄，文字被切成很短的片段，前两款产品的行显得过高，横向比较需要频繁移动视线。续航和重量表头仍换行，重量单位仍单独成行。","cause":"评价列仅 70px，扣除边距后只有 49px 的文字空间；续航和重量列各 51px，实际可用空间仍不足以让这些表头及重量数值与单位按图中浏览器的排版结果完整显示。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"价格保持完整，型号和重量比 r2A 略宽，评价比 r2B 略宽。","problems":"屏幕面板类型仍被拆开，评价仍形成很窄的竖条，整体高度与 r2B 相同；续航和重量表头、重量数值与单位仍分行。","cause":"屏幕列仍为 55px，容不下最长面板类型；评价列 77px 未达到能减少这些长评价行数的宽度门槛。续航列 46px、重量列 51px 仍然偏窄。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"均衡修正","widths":[50,71,60,51,51,76],"change":"将屏幕列扩至 60px，保住 OLED 和 LTPO；型号列缩至恰能容纳最长标识的 50px，把空间分给续航、重量和评价。观察评价列 76px 时行高能否改善。"},{"name":"评价优先","widths":[50,71,60,46,47,85],"change":"保留完整价格和屏幕面板类型，将节省出的空间集中给评价，争取改善长段文字的阅读节奏；接受续航和重量表头及单位换行。"},{"name":"续航折中","widths":[50,71,60,51,47,80],"change":"在完整保留屏幕面板类型的同时，给续航比 r2A 更多空间，并将评价列增至 80px；通过与另外两案比较，判断评价行数是否跨过换行门槛。"}]}
